 #WePowerYourTalent 
 The energy transition happens through people who see their role beyond tasks and understand that what they do has a real impact.
 At PPC, we contribute every day to a safer and cleaner energy system, from the networks that connect communities, to renewable energy that transforms the energy mix, or solutions that make electric mobility accessible.
 Regardless of the role, our contribution is reflected every day in the communities we serve, in the customers who choose us, and in an energy system that is constantly evolving. We are present across the entire energy value chain and we are looking for motivated people to join us.
 If you are curious to understand things in depth, responsible for seeing them through to completion, and open to working in a continuously changing environment, then your place is with us.
 What you will do 
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a purpose greater than daily tasks: making energy safer, more sustainable, and closer to people.
 Together with us, you have the chance to grow everyday, contributing to energy transition, having the following responsibilities :
Build, train, and deploy machine learning models efficiently with the managed infrastructure and automation capabilities of AWS SageMaker.
Utilize Amazon Redshift and S3 for data storage, processing, and analysis.
Utilize Apache Spark and Airflow for large-scale data processing and pipeline orchestration.
Manage and optimize machine learning workloads on Amazon EMR
Collaborate with data engineers to ensure seamless integration of ML models into production environments.
Implement best practices for model versioning, monitoring, and continuous deployment.
 We want you to join our journey with: 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field – completed or ongoing
Understanding of fundamental concepts in machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI, with some hands-on experience through projects, coursework, or internships.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, and familiarity with basic software engineering practices such as version control (e.g., Git).
Solid programming expertise in Python (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn).
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Good English knowledge (upper intermediate level).
Innovative & Team player.
 What we offer you 
 🚀 A place where you grow, not just work 
Clear professional and personal development paths
Access to courses, mentoring, and coaching programs
Role-relevant certifications
Real internal mobility opportunities within the PPC Romania Group
 💛 A fair package that reflects your contribution 
Fixed annual bonus (equivalent of one salary) + performance bonus
Meal vouchers worth 45 RON/day and bonuses (Energy Day, Easter, Christmas, etc.)
Partial reimbursement of vacation costs (2,400 RON)
Additional vacation days + extra days off (birthday, Energy Day)
Pillar III pension contribution worth 100 RON
Bonus for employee referrals: ranging between 1,800 RON – 7,200 RON gross depending on the role
Reimbursement for vision devices up to 700 RON, once every 2 years
Voucher for partial compensation of energy consumption
 🏥 Real support for your well-being 
Medical subscription / private insurance
Access to Bookster
Partner offers
 🖥️ Flexibility that respects your rhythm 
Hybrid schedule (office & smart working)
Short Friday
 What else you should know 
 Recruitment process confidentiality 
 At PPC, we respect the confidentiality of every application. Only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview, and all other applications will be stored in our database for a maximum of one year.
 About PPC 
 The PPC Group companies in Romania place responsibility towards the communities in which they operate, the environment, customers, and employees at the forefront of their activities. We are committed to promoting energy efficiency at a time when the effects of excessive energy consumption are proving increasingly harmful to the planet.
 We believe that together we can build a safer and cleaner future, and we invest in this direction through each of our initiatives.
 PPC contributes to the transformation of Romania’s energy sector through electricity supply and distribution activities, renewable energy generation, and the development of electric mobility. We serve millions of customers, invest in smart grids and sustainable solutions, and take an active role in accelerating the transition towards a cleaner, more affordable, and more efficient energy future.
 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion 
 We believe energy comes from people. At PPC, every voice matters, and diversity is the engine of our innovation. Regardless of age, ethnicity, gender, or disability, we offer an inclusive environment where you can grow and perform.
 🔹 # EnergyForEveryone – for your career, for the future, for all
